test_description: Syndrome bit range — verify all 256 valid (s_x in 0..15, s_z in 0..15) combinations and inspect out-of-range s_x/s_z >= 16 handling
input_contract: 4-bit s_x in [0,15] and 4-bit s_z in [0,15]; out-of-range uint8_t >= 16 must be rejected rather than silently aliased

expected.out_of_range_sx16_sz255: Explicit error / rejection before silent 4-bit aliasing

actual.out_of_range_sx16_sz255: Silently masked to s_x=0, s_z=15 and accepted

assertion_notes: avid_pack_packet_u64 silently aliases out-of-range s_x=16 to s_x=0 (no-error syndrome)
